name: SmartPay Invoices for WooCommerce
author: starnetwork

sections.description:
SMARTPAY-Invoices is a WordPress plugin designed to simplify invoice creation and management within your WooCommerce store. This plugin allows you to automatically generate invoices for your orders, ensuring that your customers receive accurate and professional billing information. Integrated seamlessly with WooCommerce, SMARTPAY-Invoices offers features such as invoice number generation, custom branding options, and PDF downloads, making it an essential tool for any eCommerce store looking to streamline its invoicing process.

Features

  • **Automatic Invoice Generation: Automatically create invoices for each completed order in your WooCommerce store.
  • **Customizable Invoice Templates: Personalize your invoices with your store’s logo, branding, and color scheme.
  • **Sequential Invoice Numbering: Ensure unique, sequential invoice numbers for easy tracking and organization.
  • **PDF Download Option: Allow customers and store admins to download invoices in PDF format for easy record-keeping.
  • **Multi-currency Support: Handle invoices in various currencies, based on your WooCommerce settings.
  • **Tax Management: Automatically calculate and display taxes on invoices, ensuring accurate billing.
  • **Email Notifications: Send automatic invoice emails to customers once an order is marked as completed.
  • **Simple Integration: Seamlessly integrate with your existing WooCommerce setup without any complicated configurations.
  • **Secure and Reliable: Maintain a secure and efficient invoicing process for your store, ensuring data integrity and customer trust.

Configuration

  1. Enter your SmartPay.co.il API credentials.
  2. Customize additional settings as needed.

Support

For any issues or inquiries, please contact our support team via smartpay.

Contributors

A big thanks to the following contributors who have helped make SMARTPAY-Invoices possible:
– StarNetwork
– SmartPay.co.il

External services

The plugin sends API requests to the following domains depending on operation mode selected (production or sandobx):
– https://app11.smartpay.co.il/
– https://api.protected-payment.com/

Privacy

Privacy policy: https://www.smartpay.co.il/privacy-policy/

License

This plugin is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smartpay-invoices folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your SmartPay.co.il API credentials in the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
Q: How do I obtain SmartPay.co.il API credentials?

A: You can obtain your API credentials by contacting SmartPay.co.il support.

Q: Is this plugin compatible with the latest version of WooCommerce?

A: Yes, this plugin is regularly updated to ensure compatibility with the latest WooCommerce releases.
